overview: This record begins while Serbia was part of a federation with Montenegro. The state union changed in 2003 and ended in 2006, after which Serbia continued separately. Modern Serbian life includes family celebrations, skilled pottery, education and public institutions, alongside the consequences of conflict and contested political boundaries.

periods.title: Within the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia
periods.summary: Serbia belonged to the federation whose United Nations admission came in 2000.

periods.title: Serbia and Montenegro
periods.summary: A revised state union used the name Serbia and Montenegro.

periods.title: A continuing separate state
periods.summary: Serbia continued the union’s United Nations membership after Montenegro’s independence.

items.text: The Federal Republic of Yugoslavia entered the United Nations in November 2000. Its official name changed to Serbia and Montenegro in 2003. These dates explain why a map labelled Serbia in the 1990s needs a federal context.

Montenegro declared independence in June 2006. Serbia continued the former union’s United Nations membership, while Montenegro joined separately. A change in international representation is one documented way to follow the institutional transition.

Serbia’s new constitution was approved by referendum in October 2006 and proclaimed in November. It defines state institutions and legal rights. A constitution is evidence of stated rules; it is not proof that every rule is fulfilled in practice.

Some Orthodox families celebrate Slava in honour of a patron saint, gathering relatives, friends and neighbours. UNESCO’s 2014 record describes a decorated cake, wine and a candle. This is a specific religious family tradition, not a universal Serbian custom.

Knowledge of Slava is passed through families, with women playing a major teaching role in the documented practice. Preparing food and welcoming guests help transmit social knowledge as well as religious meaning.

Zlakusa potters mix clay with calcite and shape vessels on a wheel turned by hand. Making a pot takes several stages over seven to ten days, including drying and firing. The cooking vessel has already required patience before dinner begins.

The craft produces pots and pans suited to cooking and serving, with shapes adapted to modern kitchens. Learners work alongside experienced makers; school classes and public demonstrations also help. Tradition here includes practical adaptation.

Народна банка Србије means “National Bank of Serbia.” The name appears in Serbian Cyrillic and Latin letters on the 2003 hundred-dinar note. Its official design specification supplies a precise witness for this short sample of modern written Serbian.

The note’s Nikola Tesla imagery includes an electromagnetic engine. Its specification also describes features visible under infrared and ultraviolet light. Scientific commemoration and anti-counterfeiting technology share the same everyday object.

The floods of 2014 damaged schools and disrupted healthcare. Some schools became temporary shelters and others ended the year early. UNICEF’s account shows why protecting children’s routines includes safe buildings, clean surroundings and functioning public services.

sections.title: Conflict and the limits of a map

items.text: Fighting in Kosovo in 1998 to 1999 displaced civilians and destroyed homes; NATO began air strikes against Yugoslavia in March 1999. The United Nations documented humanitarian consequences. A political map cannot convey the experiences of families forced to move.

Kosovo declared independence in 2008. The International Court of Justice concluded in 2010 that the declaration did not violate international law. That narrow finding was not a ruling requiring every state to recognize Kosovo, and does not by itself validate this atlas’s borders.

ending.text: Serbia continues as a state after the 2006 end of its union with Montenegro. Its present-day institutions and communities did not begin from nothing at the atlas’s 1994 starting snapshot. Kosovo’s separate declaration and international legal debate require explicit treatment rather than a claim that one map colour resolves them.
